relationships.subject: mGpTx1-SA
relationships.evidence_quote: mGpTx1-SA was found to be potent and selective for hNav1.7 activity, with IC50 values of 40.3 ± 3.2 nM for hNav1.7

relationships.subject: mGpTx1
relationships.evidence_quote: similar to 4-aminopyridine (4-AP) which is a rKv4.2/4.3 blocker, 5 µM mGpTx1 significantly prolonged action potential duration (APD) in rat cardiomyocytes

relationships.subject: mGpTx1-SA
relationships.evidence_quote: mGpTx1-SA exhibits no effect on the currents of hNav1.4, hNav1.5, rNav1.8.

key_findings: Eight spider venom Nav1.7 peptide toxins inhibit Kv4.2/4.3 off-target via a conserved S3-S4 linker binding motif with overlapping pharmacophore
Rationally engineered mGpTx1-SA keeps hNav1.7 inhibition, loses Kv4.2/4.3 inhibition and cardiotoxicity, and is analgesic in CFA and SNI mouse models
